metadata.title: PERSEUS: Multi-state LANDIS-II calibration framework — v1.0

creators.name: Weiskittel, Aaron R.
creators.affiliation: Center for Research on Sustainable Forests, University of Maine

metadata.description:
Reproducible calibration framework for LANDIS-II Biomass Succession against the USDA Forest Inventory and Analysis (FIA) multi-cycle hindcast, demonstrated across Maine, Georgia, and Washington forests. Includes:

  • Per-plot scenario builder pipeline (single-cell 1×1 30m architecture)
  • Four-tier calibration ladder (uniform θ → per-ecoregion → per-species CMA-ES)
  • Five validated stress + validation tests (k-fold CV, time-out-of-sample, leave-one-ecoregion-out, cross-state, bootstrap CI)
  • Six validated disturbance extension parameter files (Original Wind, Original Fire, Climate BDA / spruce budworm / southern pine beetle / mountain pine beetle, Hurricane v3)
  • Interactive PERSEUS Carbon Atlas (static HTML, no server required)

Calibrated best-fit parameter vectors for Maine (Tier 2 per-species, 26 params), Georgia (Tier 1 θ=0.30), and Washington (Tier 1 θ=0.30 active-growth optimum), plus Washington Tier 1.5 per-ecoregion vector capturing wet-side / dry-side productivity gradient.

Paper-novel methodological contribution: calibration degeneracy diagnostic. At very low θ, LANDIS-II produces near-zero growth across the projection horizon; the likelihood minimum becomes a trivial fit where predicted ≈ FIA observed because both stay near the initial condition. The active-growth fraction (proportion of plots with >5% biomass change over 100 yr) is the recommended diagnostic for production calibration selection.

Built on the LANDIS-II v8 .NET 8 Type.GetType DLL patches (also in this repository under console-patch/) that enable extension loading in the Foundation v1.1 Apptainer image.
